# PDFTailor - Online PDF Converter & Document Tools

> Fast, private, and secure online PDF toolkit. PDFTailor runs core operations directly inside the user's browser using WebAssembly and processes conversions in volatile ephemeral memory with zero server file retention.

## Available Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://pdftailor.com/merge-pdf): Combine PDFs in the order you want with the easiest PDF merger available.
- [Split PDF](https://pdftailor.com/split-pdf): Separate one page or a whole set for easy conversion into independent PDF files.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdftailor.com/compress-pdf): Reduce file size while optimizing for maximal PDF quality.
- [PDF to Word](https://pdftailor.com/pdf-to-word): Easily convert your PDF files into easy to edit DOC and DOCX documents. The converted WORD document is almost 100% accurate.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://pdftailor.com/pdf-to-powerpoint): Turn your PDF files into easy to edit PPT and PPTX slide decks.
- [PDF to Excel](https://pdftailor.com/pdf-to-excel): Pull data straight from PDFs into Excel spreadsheets in a few short seconds.
- [Word to PDF](https://pdftailor.com/word-to-pdf): Make DOC and DOCX files easy to read by converting them to PDF.

## Privacy & Security Architecture

- **Client-Side Execution**: Browser-native tools (Merge, Split, Compress) execute 100% locally on the client machine via WebAssembly. User files are never uploaded to any remote server.
- **Ephemeral Server-Assisted Conversions**: Server-assisted tools (Word to PDF, PDF to Office formats) stream documents over TLS into volatile isolated containers and permanently purge all temporary artifacts immediately upon conversion completion.
- **Zero Document Retention**: PDFTailor retains zero user documents, logs no sensitive document text, and enforces strict zero-retention policies.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [AI Resource Catalog (ARD Manifest)](https://pdftailor.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Structured JSON listing for autonomous AI agents.
